exact_results: The selector query fixes the activation repair bit h_p=1; the p=0 base mode is an input promise, not a branch available to the target decision.
All XOR-wire repair bits equal h_p, so the signal distributor contracts deterministically.
Projected activation PIX satisfies G_r(a,x,y) iff a*e=0 and e*(x XOR r)=0 with e=1 XOR x XOR y.
At a=1 every interface is exactly x XOR y=1, independent of r.
The hard fiber is B(X) AND E(X)=0 for the pair-defect map E_i=1 XOR x_i XOR y_i.
Direct pair substitution removes the glue layer but reconstructs the signed degree-4 NAE hard core on the DDD reduction family.

source_binding.statement: Positive Linear 3-Disjoint NAE-(2,3)-SAT-E3 is NP-complete even if every variable appears in exactly one 2-clause.

active_gate.target: Polynomial witness-preserving compression/solution of zero-syndrome membership 0 in E(Mod(B)) for the easy fanout-2 base, without merely substituting pairs back into the degree-4 hard core.
